summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $1B+ accumulations in SPX 7000C contracts expiring in late 2026. While intraday sentiment in QQQ, SPY, and NDX shows bearish hedging (high P/C ratios), the massive premium flowing into SPX 7000C and 8000P suggests institutions are building a "long-vol" or "tail-hedge" structure centered around a massive multi-year rally. The persistent accumulation of SPX 7000C (exp 2026-10-16) totaling over $3.4B across 4 sessions indicates high-conviction, structural buying of deep ITM calls. Traders should watch for whether the intraday bearishness in NDX and IWM persists or if the massive SPX call premiums begin to drive price action higher toward the 7000 level.
